title: App Builder Approved Intake Bundle
description: Everything needed to recreate an approved Build Contract and Manifest without asking the operator to re-key questionnaire answers. It carries approved intent, never generated output.

replacesUnrecoverableIntake.description: Set only when this bundle stands in for an approved intake that genuinely cannot be recovered. It is a new baseline, not a reconstruction of the lost original.

benchmark.description: Set only when the business this bundle describes does not exist. A benchmark input carries testimonials, awards, projects and people invented on purpose, and the one thing that must never happen is for that material to be read as a claim about a real company. Recording it here rather than beside the file means the declaration travels with the artifact: a bundle replayed somewhere else still says what it is. A real business does not carry this object at all, so its absence is not a claim and its presence is unambiguous.

truthPurpose.description: What the invented truth exists to measure. Widen when a second kind of benchmark earns it.

publicationAllowed.description: Output may be reviewed and photographed as benchmark evidence. It may never be published as a company's website.

externalVerification.description: There is no register, no site and no third party to check against. `unverified` would imply someone could have checked.

corpus.description: The corpus class this case belongs to, so genuine-business and benchmark metrics cannot be summed by accident.

acceptedDefaults.description: Questions the operator left at the questionnaire default, with the evidence recorded at approval time. A default is a decision, so replay must show it as one.
